question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

APJ Abdul Kalam’s house, located on Mosque Street was within the reach of the famous temple of Rameswaram. It was just ________ from it.
solution:
The correct answer is **'a stone's throw away'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• We need to substitute the given blank with an** appropriate idiom **from the **given options.**
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the** given idioms:**
